scope: Actual libfusion.so predictions through the project-private runtime; no physical QPU or Docker

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=dashboard QHAI_RUN_NATIVE_PREDICTIONS=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s dashboard/tests/backend -p test_qperfsim_virtual.py -v

verification.note: The two opt-in virtual native tests were executed by the first command. This command also verifies the existing native H2O GPU/QPU reference adapter.

circuit.interpretation: One batch = shots / effective shot rate + submission latency. The native output does not add measurement/reset time a second time. Sensitivity changes are test-only snapshots, not editable UI presets.
circuit.ideal_numerical_invariance: CPU statevector Bell probabilities remain 00=0.5 and 11=0.5 for all four variants. Changing throughput/submission latency preserves sampled counts at fixed shots/seed; increasing shots changes total counts but not ideal probabilities.

cpu_model.scope: Forward dense layers and bias; excludes activation, normalization and Python scheduling overhead. Other fixed host stages retain their disclosed reference envelopes.

preview_without_native: Passed: task graph and scenario produced despite unavailable library and nonexistent private loader; no predicted latency returned
parameter_scope: Illustrative, uncalibrated throughput model. Grid displayed only; no routing, gate-depth or noise effects.
